subject: english
title: Unit 7 Grammar 1
subtitle: The Time Machine — used to for past habits: used to + verb, didn't use to + verb, and Did ... use to ...?

content: Describe past habits with used to + verb.
Contrast how the past was different from now using used to ... but now ...
Complete and judge the true/false sentences in Student Book p. 120, Activity 1.
language: Form the affirmative: I/You/He/She/We/They + used to + base verb.
Form the negative: didn't use to + base verb — used loses its -d after didn't.
Form questions: Did + subject + use to + base verb?
Pronounce the /j/ glide at the start of used (Sounds of English Cards 23-24).
